spraywall.title: Spray walls
spraywall.intro: Pick holds off a photo and set your own problem.
spraywall.not_ready_body: The gym has not photographed and labelled this wall's holds, so there is nothing to build a problem from.
spraywall.empty_body: Nobody has set a problem on this wall. Be the first.
spraywall.load_failed: Could not load this wall's problems.
spraywall.image_failed: Could not load the wall photo.
spraywall.no_holds_body: The gym has photographed this wall but its holds are not labelled yet.
spraywall.tap_hint: Tap a hold to cycle: hand → start → foot → finish → off.
spraywall.foot_rule_hint_marked: Only the holds you mark as feet may be used.
spraywall.foot_rule_hint_follow_hands: Any hand hold may also be used as a foot.
spraywall.foot_rule_hint_screw_ons: Only the wall's screw-on footholds may be used.
spraywall.need_start: Mark at least one start hold.
spraywall.need_finish: Mark at least one finish hold.
spraywall.need_three: Mark one more hold. | Mark {n} more hold. | Mark {n} more holds.
spraywall.photo_gone: The photo this problem was set on is no longer available.
spraywall.pending_notice: Waiting for a setter to review it. Only you can see it until then.
spraywall.foot_rule_explain_marked: You mark specific holds as footholds, and only those may be used for feet. The most precise option, and the most work to set: on a busy wall you may be marking a lot of holds.
spraywall.foot_rule_explain_follow_hands: Any hold you marked for hands may also be stood on. Nothing extra to mark, and the usual choice on a dense spray wall where marking every foothold would take longer than the climb.
spraywall.foot_rule_explain_screw_ons: Only the small screw-on footholds bolted to the wall may be used — none of the holds in the problem. The hardest of the three, since your feet are limited to whatever the gym screwed on.
spraywall.foot_rule_change_body: This rule has no marked feet, so the one hold you marked as a foot will be cleared. | This rule has no marked feet, so the {n} hold you marked as a foot will be cleared. | This rule has no marked feet, so the {n} holds you marked as feet will be cleared.
spraywall.cannot_tick_yet: This problem cannot be ticked until a setter approves it.
spraywall.adjust_note: The gym sets how this wall looks by default. Save your own if you prefer something else.
spraywall.name_hint: A spray wall problem has no tag, so the name is how people find it.
spraywall.zoom_explainer_tap: Double-tap the wall to zoom in on that spot.
spraywall.zoom_explainer_controls: While zoomed, Zoom out and Reset zoom appear at the top and bottom of the photo. Drag to move around.
spraywall.pending_public_notice: Not reviewed by a setter yet. It may still change or be removed.
spraywall.comment_prompt: Comments are public. What is your comment?
spraywall.comment_thanks: Thanks. Your comment appears once a moderator approves it.
spraywall.comment_failed: Could not save your comment. Try again.

report.title: Something wrong with this route?
report.thanks: Thanks — the routesetters have been told.
report.failed: Could not send the report. Try again later.
report.note_placeholder: e.g. second bolt is loose, holds greasy near the top

training.title: Training
training.invite_explains: They will be able to set you training programs and see the sessions and ticks you log. You can end it at any time.
training.nothing_yet: No training programs yet. A coach can set you one.
training.no_dates: This programme has no start date, so it has no calendar — the weeks run in order from whenever you begin.
training.rest_explainer: A rest day. Nothing prescribed — recovery is the training.
